WITH store AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE store_name = 'old-town Bratislava PowerTool store' LIMIT 1), specs AS (SELECT 'Facom' AS brand, 'Facom Comfort Grip R 339-4WO Screwdriver and Hex Key Set' AS family_name, 'tool profile' AS prop_key, 'torx' AS prop_val UNION ALL SELECT 'Bostik', 'Bostik Professional BST 30G-CNL Adhesive and Glue', 'adhesive type', 'mounting adhesive' UNION ALL SELECT 'Bostik', 'Bostik Professional BST 30G-CNL Adhesive and Glue', 'color family', 'Black' UNION ALL SELECT 'Milwaukee', 'Milwaukee Heavy Duty PACKOUT 2B6-RBF Tool Box and Bag', 'storage type', 'sortainer' UNION ALL SELECT 'Milwaukee', 'Milwaukee Heavy Duty PACKOUT 2B6-RBF Tool Box and Bag', 'color family', 'Clear' UNION ALL SELECT 'Really Useful Box', 'Really Useful Box Stackable RUB S2P-7Y6 Storage Bin and Organizer', 'storage type', 'parts case' UNION ALL SELECT 'Really Useful Box', 'Really Useful Box Stackable RUB S2P-7Y6 Storage Bin and Organizer', 'color family', 'Black' UNION ALL SELECT 'Really Useful Box', 'Really Useful Box Stackable RUB S2P-7Y6 Storage Bin and Organizer', 'volume', '8 l' UNION ALL SELECT 'Varta', 'Varta Winter Silver 1K5-1ZB Automotive Charger and Bulb', 'product type', 'battery charger' UNION ALL SELECT 'Varta', 'Varta Winter Silver 1K5-1ZB Automotive Charger and Bulb', 'voltage', '6 V' UNION ALL SELECT 'Black+Decker', 'Black+Decker Classic KA 1D0-UK7 Cordless Saw and Sander', 'tool type', 'circular saw' UNION ALL SELECT 'Black+Decker', 'Black+Decker Classic KA 1D0-UK7 Cordless Saw and Sander', 'voltage', '12 V'), matched AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN specs s ON pv.brand = s.brand AND pf.product_family_name = s.family_name JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = s.prop_key AND pvp.property_value_text = s.prop_val GROUP BY pv.product_sku, pv.record_path HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.rowid) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM specs s2 WHERE s2.brand = pv.brand AND s2.family_name = pf.product_family_name)) SELECT m.record_path FROM matched m JOIN store_inventory si ON m.product_sku = si.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) WHERE si.available_today_quantity >= 1;
